definitions.explanation: The string of a bow used in archery. In the context of Japanese archery, it refers to the string of a traditional longbow.

examples.japanese: {弓弦|ゆみづる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧。
{弓弦|ゆみづる}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The bowstring broke, so I replaced it with a new one.

examples.english: In kyudo practice, you first learn how to string the bow and how to care for the bowstring.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{弓|ゆみ}→弓：08430_yumi⟧ (bow) and {弦|つる} (string). Also written as {弓弦|ゆみつる} without the voicing, though {弓弦|ゆみづる} is more common. The alternate reading {弓弦|ゆづる} also exists and is used as a personal name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弓弦|ゆみづる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: string a bow
- {弓弦|ゆみづる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: draw the bowstring
- {弓弦|ゆみづる}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: the bowstring breaks
- {弓弦|ゆみづる}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧: the sound of the bowstring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弦|つる}: string (general term for strings on bows and musical instruments)
- ⟦{弓|ゆみ}→弓：08430_yumi⟧: bow (the weapon/instrument itself)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In ⟦{弓道|きゅうどう}→弓道：04453_kyuudou⟧ (Japanese archery), the bowstring is traditionally made from plant fibers. The sharp twang of the released {弓弦|ゆみづる} is considered part of the aesthetic of ⟦{弓道|きゅうどう}→弓道：04453_kyuudou⟧. In folklore, the sound of a bowstring was believed to drive away evil spirits.
